response.sql: SELECT b.player_id, SUM(b.triple) AS total_triples FROM batting_postseason AS b WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM batting_postseason AS q WHERE q.player_id = b.player_id AND q.league_id = 'NL' AND q.round = 'WS') GROUP BY b.player_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(b.triple) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, total_triples DESC LIMIT 10;
